description:
Set the all-lock flag on the active layer. `locked: true` blocks further edits to that layer; `false` clears the lock.

Use when: the user asks to lock or unlock the current layer.
Do NOT use when: the layer should only be hidden — use photoshop_set_layer_visibility.
Do NOT use when: a different layer is the target — use photoshop_select_layer_by_name first.

Returns: confirmation of the lock state.
Preconditions: active document and active layer. Side effects: sets layer.allLocked. The same boolean is idempotent. Reversible with photoshop_undo or by calling again with the opposite value.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool activates that document before running so a UI tab switch cannot retarget the edit.

locked.description: Whether the layer should be locked

name: photoshop_set_layer_locked
